column1: # Non-vendored public PDF corpus captured on 2026-08-21.
# Validate byte_count and sha256 after download, then compare each file with itself using --strict.
# expected_exit records supported completion and intentionally explicit unsupported, unresolved, or fatal boundaries.
# print_protection requires both password-file options with the public fixture password.
# thuluth-features requires matching `TraditionalArabic` font-identity assertions for both sides.
# pages-tree-refs exits 0 without --strict after retaining one valid page; strict remains incomplete.
